name: gb_interrupts

provenance.read_for: this card's data and logic, written here

sources: Gekkio, Game Boy: Complete Technical Reference
statement: IE (FFFF) and IF (FF0F): five interrupt sources, bit 0 highest priority. Dispatch: 5 M-cycles (two internal, push PC high, push PC low, jump); the vector is chosen after the high byte is pushed, so a push that clears IE sends the CPU to 0x0000. Waking from HALT takes one more M-cycle.
